connector.name: E Arveldaja MCP
connector.registryDescription: Estonian e-arveldaja (RIK e-Financials) accounting - invoices, bank import, reports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package e-arveldaja-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the iseppo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_API_KEY_ID
env.description: RIK e-arveldaja API key ID. Can alternatively be supplied via a .env file or an apikey*.txt file in the working directory.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_API_PUBLIC_VALUE
env.description: RIK e-arveldaja API public value. Can alternatively be supplied via a .env file or an apikey*.txt file in the working directory.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_API_PASSWORD
env.description: RIK e-arveldaja API password (HMAC signing secret). Can alternatively be supplied via a .env file or an apikey*.txt file in the working directory.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_SERVER
env.description: Which RIK server to target. "live" (default) or "demo".

env.name: EARVELDAJA_ALLOWED_PATHS
env.description: Platform-separated (colon on Linux/macOS, semicolon on Windows) list of directories that file-reading tools are allowed to read from. Defaults to the working directory and the OS temp dir.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_DISABLE_PROGRESS
env.description: Set to "1" or "true" to disable MCP progress notifications. Workaround for clients that close the stdio transport when a progress notification arrives after the matching response has been processed.

env.name: EARVELDAJA_LOG_FILE
env.description: Absolute path to a regular file. When set, everything the server writes to stderr is also appended to this file (mode 0o600). Off by default. Cross-platform. Useful when the MCP host swallows stderr. Pipes, devices, sockets, /dev/stdout, and /proc/self/fd/* are refused so the tee cannot corrupt the MCP stdio transport.
